summary: All ST-008 acceptance criteria are met. The codebase is fully aligned with ARCHITECTURE.md. packages/ directory does not exist. Zero package:nextone_core/ or package:models/ imports anywhere in lib/ or test/. Zero flutter_hooks imports in lib/. No HookWidget subclasses remain. No auto_mappr files remain. Dead mapper files (lib/data/mappers/) and the old nested repository/service sub-subdirectories were deleted and replaced with the flat structure defined in ARCHITECTURE.md. The artist DTO folder was correctly renamed from dto/artist_dto/ to dto/artist/. models.dart barrel no longer exports mappers — only api_responses and dto exports. injection.config.dart uses package:nextone/ imports throughout (preferRelativeImports was changed to false). loading_splash_page.dart has a mounted check inside the Future.delayed callback before navigation. profile_setup_page.dart calls removeListener before disposing all four controllers. All .withOpacity() deprecated calls were replaced. dart analyze: No issues found. flutter test: 9 tests passed. flutter build apk --debug: Built successfully (non-blocking Gradle/AGP/Kotlin toolchain upgrade warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to the refactor). The carry-forward items from ST-001 through ST-007 have all been resolved or documented.

issues.description: flutter build apk --debug emits three non-blocking future-deprecation warnings about Gradle 8.3.0 (minimum 8.7.0), Android Gradle Plugin 8.2.1 (minimum 8.6.0), and Kotlin 1.8.22 (minimum 2.1.0). These are toolchain upgrade advisories and do not block the build. The APK was produced successfully. These warnings pre-date the refactor and are out of scope for refactor-001.
issues.evidence: Build output: '✓ Built build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk' with three Warning: lines about Gradle/AGP/Kotlin versions.
